data_source_description: Data from the Food Research Laboratory (FRL) of the Centre for Food Safety (CFS), Food and Environmental Hygiene Department, Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

analytical_methodology.protein: Total nitrogen determined by Kjeldahl method, multiplied by protein conversion factor 6.25
analytical_methodology.total_fat: Gravimetric method: acid hydrolysis followed by ether and petroleum ether extraction
analytical_methodology.available_carbohydrate: Calculated by difference: 100g minus total grams of water, protein, fat, ash and dietary fibre
analytical_methodology.energy_kcal_equation: Energy = (4 x g protein) + (4 x g available carbohydrate) + (9 x g total fat) + (7 x g alcohol), rounded to nearest 10 kcal for values >= 100 kcal in CFS reporting table
analytical_methodology.fat_presence_explanation: 1.1g fat per 100g originates from the vegetable release oil applied by dim sum chefs onto the steaming cloth/stainless steel tray to allow seamless peeling of the cooked rice sheet
